items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: and a couple other jobs, you probably were on with me, with Cindy Castane, with things like that.

ctx.x: And Henry asked him, he said, what'd you fire me for? He said, we don't need you no more. We're doing business. We don't need a man anymore. Uh-huh. So, they, then he let him go. And, uh, Joe never would have told me that, but, uh, Henry did tell me that, because I was, I worked with Henry after, after I left Pete. And I was with Henry with, who was booking most of the Lou Wopps jobs. And, uh, in fact, we had quite a, with Rene, he didn't want, he didn't want Henry to use me.
